title: Wonderful food adventure
text: Jennifer was absolutely amazing and a must request guide for this tour.   She was funny, knowledgeable about the food and history of the neighborhoods.   She knew many of the people working at the restaurants to make you feel like a little bit less of a tourist.  Would 100% book again.
author: 134kristie

title: Immersive
text: Enjoyable and fascinating food tour with Horacio.

title: Great Tour Guide and delicious food
text: Patricia was a great tour guide. Very professionell, friendly and knowlegeable. My Family enjoyed a lot the tour and the shared pictures about her cats. Thank you
author: Andreas_G

title: Babs and Friends Tour Barcelona
text: Simon and Sharon were amazing guides through our tapas and food tour of Barcelona!  They both have extensive knowledge of the city and shared there lives here as well as the local culture.   I highly recommend visiting them to help you make your trip to Barcelona most memorable!
author: BabsChoices

title: J&J’s food tour in Barcelona
text: Some great and different foods to sample. Victoria was a pleasure and had lots of interesting facts about the food and the city.
author: Jonathan_C

title: Our favorite!!
text: This tour was simply amazing! Simon was so kind and wonderful and brought us to some really yummy restaurants! We even needed to get cough medicine for our son at the pharmacy and she was so helpful. All the food on this tour was absolutely delicious!! And the wine was very good too! If you’re looking for a personalized tour in Barcelona, I recommend this 100%!!!!
author: Kimberlee_N

title: We had so much fun...
text: We had so much fun exploring and eating our way through Barcelona with Brunella!  We explored neighborhoods we had never been to, and learned about the different types of local cuisine.
author: Kymberly_G

title: All the pinxas!
text: Great food! Excellent Catalon history! Our tour guide also was able to adjust to her contents to accommodate our 10-year-old daughter as well as a holiday that caused the market to be closed. Would definitely do it again!
